data.action: 身穿黄色连体泳装赤足在浅滩踩水戏水，双手撩起水花，长双马尾飞舞开怀大笑
data.camera: full body, three-quarter view, feet grounded in the shallow water
data.description: 【惣流·明日香 · 第三村海滩黄色泳装戏水】阳光普照的晴朗海滩浅水区，碧蓝的海浪卷着洁白的泡沫涌上沙滩。明日香身着元气满满的明黄色系带连体泳衣，展现出青春健美的完美身姿。她赤着双足涉水在浪花之中，两只小手撩起清澈的海水向你泼来。橘红色的长双马尾在海风中如烈火般欢快飞舞，清澈的蓝色双眸笑得像月牙一样明媚，毫无阴霾地大喊——「笨蛋真嗣！动作这么慢，快点跟上本小姐啦！」
data.lighting: 海面闪烁着无数碎金般的光斑与明澈透亮夏日晴空
data.location: 阳光明媚的浅海沙滩水边
data.promptProse: Asuka stands barefoot in the sunny beach shallows and scoops a small splash toward her companion with both hands, laughing in her bright-yellow one-piece swimsuit. Her orange-red twin tails and red interface clips remain clear as water droplets fall from her hands. Keep the full-body three-quarter view so both feet remain connected to the sandy seabed. White foam curls around her ankles; beyond the near ripples, successive blue waves lead toward the open horizon. Summer sunlight catches the lifted droplets and yellow shoulder straps. Reflected water light softens the shaded swimsuit fabric, while the feet's faint contact shadows and moving ripple bands anchor the splash to the shallows.
data.title: 惣流·明日香 · 第三村海滩黄色泳装戏水
